stem.text: Penicillin is an antibiotic used to treat infections caused by bacteria.
Which events explain how bacteria become resistant to penicillin?

items: The number of bacteria with the allele for resistance to penicillin increases.
Resistance to penicillin is the result of a mutation in a bacterium.
Bacteria with the allele for resistance to penicillin pass the allele to their daughter cells.
The mutation for resistance to penicillin is always caused by the presence of penicillin.
